title: Use non standard evaluation in tween_* functions
description:
Closes #2. 

I'm not sure if this is still a desired addition to `tweenr`, especially given the latest advised behaviour is to not use NSE "magic" where possible.

Use non-standard evaluation to allow bare column names and expressions in the tween_* functions:

 * `tween_appear`
 * `tween_elements`
 * `tween_state`

In each case, a SE version is added with a trailing underscore (for e.g. `tween_elements_`), as per `lazyeval`'s [NSE vignette](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/lazyeval/vignettes/lazyeval.html)
